# Pitch & Sales Scripts

## Philosophy
We are advisors, not salespeople. We diagnose first. We only pitch a scheme if it fits the client. We never oversell success rates.

---

## 1. Discovery Call Script (First Contact — 20 min)

### Opening (2 min)
Good morning/afternoon. I specialise in helping horticulture-focused entities like Farmer Producer Organisations, cooperatives, and agri-companies access government grants for cluster development. The Horticulture Cluster Development Programme (CDP) supports integrated value chain projects from production to export. I’d like to understand your current operations and see if this aligns with your growth plans.

### Discovery Questions
1. What type of legal entity is your organisation (e.g., FPO, cooperative, partnership, company)?
2. When was your organisation incorporated or registered?
3. What is your annual turnover, and does it meet or exceed the total project cost you’re considering?
4. Do you have experience in horticultural input supply, production, aggregation, processing, exporting, retailing, or logistics?
5. Are you planning to contribute at least 20% of the project cost as equity from your own funds?
6. Have you secured or are you in discussions with an RBI-approved scheduled commercial bank for a term loan covering at least 20% of the project cost?
7.0.
